## What's Changed
* Fix GitHub issue templates by @DonDae001 in https://github.com/ImranR98/Obtainium/pull/3284
* i18n: update `pl.json` by @krvstek in https://github.com/ImranR98/Obtainium/pull/3302
* Update ja.json by @bluefly000 in https://github.com/ImranR98/Obtainium/pull/3291
* Update ru.json by @solokot in https://github.com/ImranR98/Obtainium/pull/3286
* Translation: Update hu.json by @summoner001 in https://github.com/ImranR98/Obtainium/pull/3285
* Update bs.json by @Errudar in https://github.com/ImranR98/Obtainium/pull/3287
* Add Huawei AppGallery .ru host by @skrimix in https://github.com/ImranR98/Obtainium/pull/3295
* HTML source: discover URLs in parsed HTML attributes by @Scott-Nx in https://github.com/ImranR98/Obtainium/pull/3294
* Fix Uptodown downloads and add search by @skrimix in https://github.com/ImranR98/Obtainium/pull/3305
* docs:README change sig hash formatting by @master-bob in https://github.com/ImranR98/Obtainium/pull/3304
* By @ImranR98 in https://github.com/ImranR98/Obtainium/pull/3307:
  * Add an app list density setting (#2620)
  * Fix version detection, GitLab APK assets, app dir recovery and AGP build (#3215) (#2732) (#2860) (#3188)
  * Fix HTML source link extraction for relative and quoted URLs (#2816)
  * Verify APK signing certificates before installing (#2922)
  * Detect external install completion from the installer's own result (#3091)
  * Show a specific error for RuStore external-source listings (#3298)
  * Support multiple split APK URLs in one apkUrls entry (#3298)
  * Resolve RuStore split APKs using a device profile request (#3298)
  * Sum all split APK sizes in the download size probe (#3298)
  * Add shared minimum update age helpers and fix update suppression (#3303)
  * Honor the minimum update age when adding apps (#3303)
  * Skip releases younger than the minimum update age in list-based sources (#3303)
  * Refactored the source/provider structure and UI code, and reworked version detection including rolling version tags.
  * Added emulator end-to-end test suites with a local runner.
  * Broad Android TV UI/UX polish
  * Various networking and download/install related improvements
  * Various other bugfixes
* By @ImranR98 in https://github.com/ImranR98/Obtainium/pull/3308:
  * Refresh cached app icons when an app is updated (#3306)
  * Migrate to Flutter built-in Kotlin and material_ui, switch to forks of unmaintained packages, move off legacy Kotlin Gradle Plugin (#3258)
* ci: tighten up auxiliary workflows by @master-bob in https://github.com/ImranR98/Obtainium/pull/3309
* Improve APKMirror tracking with release pages, changelogs, sizes and package IDs by @ImranR98 in https://github.com/ImranR98/Obtainium/pull/3310
  * APKMirror tracking improvements include code and research adapted from ObtainX by Bikram Agarwal (@bikram-agarwal).
* Persist the ForgeJo token globally and drop GitHub-only settings (#2788) by @ImranR98 in https://github.com/ImranR98/Obtainium/pull/3313

## New Contributors
* @DonDae001 made their first contribution in https://github.com/ImranR98/Obtainium/pull/3284
* @Scott-Nx made their first contribution in https://github.com/ImranR98/Obtainium/pull/3294
